name: Methuselah
bio: Methuselah is the son of Enoch and grandfather of Noah, the longest-lived person recorded in Scripture at 969 years (Genesis 5:27). Very little else is recorded about his life; his significance lies mainly in witnessing to the great lifespans of that age, and in how his father Enoch's godly legacy of "walking with God" carried through to Noah's generation, which would ultimately face the judgment of the flood.
